name: Seattle Black Nerd Festival
blurb: A festival celebrating Black fandom and creativity across anime, gaming, cosplay, film and art, hosted by the LANGSTON arts nonprofit in Seattle's Central District.
notes: The event page now reads 'THAT'S A WRAP - THANK YOU: The second annual Seattle Black Nerd Festival was a three-day gathering...' with only a mailing-list signup for future updates; no 3rd-annual date has been announced yet. Org site is langstonseattle.org (LANGSTON Seattle, formerly Langston Hughes African American Film Festival/LHPAI); the given langstonseattle.org homepage URL redirected research to the festival's own page at /seattle-black-nerd-festival/, used as url instead. Guests not researched since no upcoming edition is announced.
